definition: Record IDs 1 through 10,000, ascending, from the retained native oracle; no deduplication. Base64-decode each morgan_fingerprint to exactly 256 bytes. Concatenate unchanged bytes with no header, separator, ID, padding or trailing newline. Row 0 is record_id 1; bit j = (byte[j//8] >> (j%8)) & 1.
operation: Byte-only prefix hash between engines; no new chemistry or performance run.
